candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség (Hungarian Banking Association) - main site
candidates.why_relevant: Peak association of Hungarian credit institutions (founded 1989). Publishes sector position papers, communiques, press releases and periodic banking-sector commentary; the central node for HU banking industry intelligence and the natural entry point to member lists, journals and reports.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of news/publication sections with polite rate limiting; PDF harvesting
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagjai lista éves jelentés bankszektor adatok
Hungarian Banking Association sector statistics publication

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség - Tagjaink (member institutions list)
candidates.why_relevant: Fetched page lists roughly 67 full and associate member institutions - OTP, MBH, K&H, Erste, CIB, Raiffeisen, UniCredit, foreign branches (Deutsche Bank, BNP Paribas, ING, Citibank Europe), mortgage banks, savings institutions, plus payment/market infrastructure members KELER and BISZ. This is the master actor map for the whole HU institutional landscape.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic (quarterly) HTML scrape and diff of the member table to track entries/exits and consolidation
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagjai lista

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség - Publikációk (publications hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Hub for association studies, reports and journals; the practical route to recurring sector analyses rather than one-off press items.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly index crawl + PDF download and text extraction
queries_used: Gazdaság és Pénzügy folyóirat Magyar Bankszövetség

candidates.source_name: Gazdaság és Pénzügy (G.É.P.) - Banking Association quarterly journal
candidates.why_relevant: Peer-style quarterly published by the Banking Association (with the Foundation for Financial Culture Development), ISSN 2677-1314 online. Carries articles on payments, digitalisation, cash usage and banking-sector economics - a durable analytic corpus. Also archived openly in REAL-J (MTAK).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Issue-level PDF harvesting; mirror via REAL-J archive for stable retrieval
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball to open archive
queries_used: Gazdaság és Pénzügy folyóirat Magyar Bankszövetség Economy and Finance journal

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség - Sajtóközlemények / Kommunikék (press releases & communiques)
candidates.why_relevant: Fastest signal channel for the banking industry's stance on payment regulation, interchange, cash-acceptance mandates, transaction levies and digital payment initiatives; often the first public sector-aggregate figures.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of the press-release and kommunikék index pages
queries_used: Bankszövetség éves jelentés bankszektor teljesítmény adatok

candidates.source_name: Bankszövetségi Krónikák (Kovács Levente) - association chronicle PDF
candidates.why_relevant: Book-length compilation including 2024 member institutions and extracts from the Association's annual-report management summaries - a rare consolidated historical baseline for the HU banking sector and its digital transition.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off PDF download and internal reference extraction (respect copyright, no redistribution)
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagjai lista éves jelentés bankszektor adatok

candidates.source_name: Országos Kereskedelmi Szövetség (OKSZ) - Hungarian Trade Association
candidates.why_relevant: Principal retail-sector interest body (founded 1990); members include Hungary's six largest food retail chains plus IKEA, Metro, Media Markt, Praktiker, dm, Foodora; member turnover reportedly exceeds HUF 5,000bn and ~1/3 of retail sales. Directly and repeatedly on the record about card acceptance vs. mandatory cash acceptance - the merchant/acceptance side of card and cash usage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /cikkek/sajtokozlemenyek and /cikkek/altalanos-hirek; extract positions and any quantified member data
queries_used: Országos Kereskedelmi Szövetség készpénzhasználat kártyaelfogadás
OKSZ.hu tagok kiadványok kiskereskedelem

candidates.source_name: EFISZ - Elektronikus Fizetési Szolgáltatók Szövetsége (Electronic Payment Service Providers Association)
candidates.why_relevant: The single most payment-specific association in the cell. Founded by nine payment-infrastructure heavyweights (GIRO Zrt., Magyar Posta, Magyar Telekom, OTP, MKB/Budapest Bank, Pénzjegynyomda, the savings-cooperative integration body, Nemzeti Mobilfizetési Zrt.). Runs its own consumer research on electronic payment awareness and use - primary payment-behaviour data outside the central bank.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of HU and EN news sections; capture survey/research releases as PDFs
queries_used: Elektronikus Fizetési Szolgáltatók Szövetsége EFISZ tagok készpénzmentes

candidates.source_name: Magyar Fintech Szövetség / Hungarian Fintech Association (HFA)
candidates.why_relevant: Umbrella body for the domestic fintech ecosystem across membership tiers (startup, scale-up, ecosystem organiser, supporting member), spanning payment solutions, aggregators, AML, crypto and banks. Its member roster is a pointer to the non-bank payment-provider landscape (e.g. Barion, SimplePay); its position papers address fintech's GDP contribution.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of member directory + news; diff membership over time
queries_used: Magyar Fintech Szövetség tagok fizetési szolgáltatók

candidates.source_name: MKIK - Magyar Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara (Hungarian Chamber of Commerce and Industry)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory national chamber; runs recurring enterprise surveys (minimum wage research, FX rapid surveys) that break out the 'financial and insurance services' sector, plus TOP100 corporate research with Corvinus and Pécs. Gives demand-side and SME-side context for payments and banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of /hirek and research pages; download survey PDFs
queries_used: MKIK Magyar Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara gazdasági elemzés kutatás jelentés

candidates.source_name: MKIK GVI - Gazdaság- és Vállalkozáskutató Intézet (Institute for Economic and Enterprise Research)
candidates.why_relevant: The chamber's research arm; has run semi-annual business-cycle surveys of Hungarian firms since 1998 with GDP-forecasting output, and publishes downloadable study PDFs. Best-structured, longest time-series association-side survey data in the cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /files/researches PDF tree; index by year and topic
queries_used: MKIK Magyar Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara gazdasági elemzés kutatás jelentés

candidates.source_name: Magyar Lízingszövetség (Hungarian Leasing Association) - quarterly market statistics
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes quarterly and annual leasing-market volumes with segmentation (e.g. HUF 909.46bn placements, 72,330 contracts, split SME 66% / large corporate 16% / individuals 6.3%). Association-aggregated member data of exactly the kind A4 needs for non-bank credit adjacent to payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of /hirek plus any statistics page; parse tables into a time series
queries_used: Magyar Lízingszövetség statisztika Magyar Faktoring Szövetség adatok

candidates.source_name: Magyar Faktoring Szövetség (Hungarian Factoring Association) - Statisztikák
candidates.why_relevant: Maintains a dedicated statistics page with member-aggregated factoring turnover and GDP penetration (turnover reported rising HUF 6,513bn to 8,023bn; penetration 7.9% to 9.2% vs ~12.5% EU average). Clean, recurring association statistics series.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of the statistics page; note a legacy path (www.faktoringszovetseg.hu/html/statisztika.html) also appears in indexes - verify which is current
queries_used: Magyar Lízingszövetség statisztika Magyar Faktoring Szövetség adatok

candidates.source_name: IVSZ - Digitális Vállalkozások Szövetsége (Association of Digital Enterprises, formerly IT/telecom association)
candidates.why_relevant: Leading interest body for the digital economy; its digitalisation positions and member base overlap with payment-technology vendors, POS/terminal integrators and IT suppliers to banks. Useful for the technology-supply side of the payments value chain rather than for payment statistics themselves.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of news and member directory; filter for payments/fintech keywords
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (technology supply side) + local-language search
queries_used: IVSZ Informatikai Vállalkozások Szövetsége digitalizáció jelentés fizetés

candidates.source_name: MNKSZ - Magyar Nemzeti Kereskedelmi Szövetség (Hungarian National Trade Association)
candidates.why_relevant: Second retail-side association alongside OKSZ, weighted toward domestically owned chains; publishes member and partner directories and participates in legislative consultation. Complements OKSZ for the acceptance side and for domestic-vs-international merchant split.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape /tagjaink and /partnereink for actor mapping; monitor /hirek
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search for secondary merchant associations
queries_used: "Magyar Nemzeti Kereskedelmi Szövetség" OR "Magyar Franchise Szövetség" kiskereskedelem kártyaelfogadás

candidates.source_name: Magyar Franchise Szövetség (Hungarian Franchise Association)
candidates.why_relevant: Founded 1991 as the interest body of the franchise business community; its member list maps multi-site retail and hospitality networks that are POS/acceptance customers - a useful secondary merchant-side actor map.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual scrape of member directory
queries_used: "Magyar Nemzeti Kereskedelmi Szövetség" OR "Magyar Franchise Szövetség" kiskereskedelem kártyaelfogadás

candidates.source_name: HVCA - Magyar Kockázati- és Magántőke Egyesület (Hungarian Private Equity and Venture Capital Association)
candidates.why_relevant: Founded 1991, ~70 members, full member of the European VC/PE association; publishes quarterly investment statistics (e.g. HUF 31.079bn into 38 companies across 39 deals in a quarter). Tracks capital flowing into Hungarian fintech/payment startups - the funding lens on the payments ecosystem.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of /hirek for investment statistics releases; scrape member list
candidates.discovered_via_method: category inference (who funds the sector) + local-language search
queries_used: Magyar Kockázati és Magántőke Egyesület HVCA fintech

candidates.source_name: MABISZ - Magyar Biztosítók Szövetsége (Association of Hungarian Insurance Companies) and its Szemle
candidates.why_relevant: Insurance peak association; its Szemle press-review republishes financial-sector items (e.g. factoring-market coverage) and MABISZ itself publishes member-aggregated insurance market statistics. Adjacent financial-sector benchmark and a secondary aggregator of HU financial trade news.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the Szemle feed as a low-cost aggregator of HU financial-sector coverage
queries_used: Magyar Faktoring Szövetség adatok

candidates.source_name: BKIK - Budapesti Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara (Budapest Chamber of Commerce and Industry)
candidates.why_relevant: Territorial chamber that republishes and localises MKIK rapid surveys, including one on the forint-euro exchange rate showing notably strong negative effects among financial and insurance services firms - i.e. sector-broken-out survey data usable for A4 context.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor economic-analysis section; treat as secondary to MKIK/GVI originals
queries_used: MKIK gazdasági elemzés kutatás jelentés

candidates.source_name: Pest Vármegyei és Érdi Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara - Felmérések, kutatások
candidates.why_relevant: Example of the county-chamber layer (there are ~19 territorial chambers, e.g. Zala: zvkik.hu) each hosting survey and research pages; regional granularity for SME payment behaviour and business conditions that the national chamber aggregates away.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the ~19 county chambers from MKIK's site, then sample their research pages annually
queries_used: MKIK Magyar Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara gazdasági elemzés kutatás jelentés

candidates.source_name: FinTechZone / Fintech.hu - association-tracking trade media (EFISZ, HFA tag feeds)
candidates.why_relevant: Trade media that systematically covers Hungarian payment/fintech associations and often carries association research summaries earlier and more accessibly than the associations' own sites; tag pages act as ready-made monitoring feeds and pointers to new association formations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to / crawl tag pages for EFISZ and Magyar Fintech Szövetség; use only as a pointer, verify figures against the association original
queries_used: Magyar Fintech Szövetség tagok fizetési szolgáltatók
Elektronikus Fizetési Szolgáltatók Szövetsége EFISZ tagok

candidates.source_name: Trade magazin - OKSZ tag feed (retail trade media)
candidates.why_relevant: FMCG/retail trade magazine with a standing tag for OKSZ; captures merchant-association statements on payment acceptance, cash mandates and checkout technology that do not always reach oksz.hu, and points to further retail-side actors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the tag page monthly; cross-check quantitative claims against OKSZ releases
queries_used: Országos Kereskedelmi Szövetség készpénzhasználat kártyaelfogadás

candidates.source_name: Wikipédia (hu) entries for Magyar Bankszövetség and Országos Kereskedelmi Szövetség
candidates.why_relevant: Low-credibility but high-yield orientation layer: gives founding dates (Bankszövetség registered Feb 1989; OKSZ founded 23 Apr 1990), officeholders, alias names and outbound links used to seed further searches. Never cite as evidence; use for glossary and entity resolution only.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off extraction of entity aliases and external links; refresh annually
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagjai lista

negative_findings.description: Searched in Hungarian for a Banking Association-published, recurring quantitative banking-sector statistics series (analogous to the German or Austrian association datasets). No association-hosted statistical dataset page surfaced; sector aggregates in results came from the MNB (central bank) and from individual banks' annual reports, not from Magyar Bankszövetség.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association output appears to be qualitative (communiques, position papers, journal articles) rather than a standing statistics series; the quantitative banking-sector series in HU sits with the MNB, which belongs to another coverage cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-tasking cell 5 with a statistics-extraction pipeline that has no target; A4 quantitative banking aggregates must be sourced from the supervisor/central bank instead.

negative_findings.description: For the Magyar Fintech Szövetség (hunfintech.com) and EFISZ (efisz.hu) I did not reach a confirmed, enumerable member-directory URL within this pass; membership information came from secondary trade-media coverage (founding members for EFISZ, member categories for HFA).
negative_findings.result_summary: Association homepages identified and confidently attributed, but the specific member-list endpoints remain unverified hypotheses rather than found URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The member lists are the highest-value pointer assets in this cell; a follow-up pass should navigate both sites directly to locate them.

negative_findings.description: Local-language searches for a Hungarian card-issuer or ATM-operator association (terms tried around bankkártya, ATM üzemeltető, kártyakibocsátó szövetség) returned no dedicated body; the functional equivalents are EFISZ on the payment-provider side and the Banking Association's internal working groups.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone HU cards/ATM association identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Card and ATM statistics for HU will not come from an association layer; expect the central bank and international card schemes to be the only aggregators.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching for 'Hungarian Banking Association sector statistics publication' returned mainly Hungarian-language assets; only EFISZ was observed to maintain an explicit /en/ path. Most association output in this cell exists in Hungarian only.
negative_findings.result_summary: English is a shallow entry point for this cell; Hungarian-language collection is mandatory rather than optional.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any downstream collector configured English-first would miss the large majority of this cell's content.

negative_findings.description: The Factoring Association appears with two statistics paths in indexes: https://faktoringszovetseg.hu/statistikak-style path and a legacy http://www.faktoringszovetseg.hu/html/statisztika.html. I did not fetch either, so neither is claimed live.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two candidate URLs recorded; canonical one to be determined by the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids anchoring a recurring collector on a stale legacy path.

coverage_gaps.description: Savings-cooperative and integration bodies (Szövetkezeti Hitelintézetek Integrációs Szervezete, OTSZ/Takarékszövetkezetek heritage bodies) were seen only as EFISZ founding members and Bankszövetség member entries; their own association sites were not searched.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated HU query set on 'Szövetkezeti Hitelintézetek Integrációs Szervezete', 'takarékszövetkezet érdekképviselet' to find surviving bodies and their publications.

coverage_gaps.description: Peak employer/business confederations (MGYOSZ/BusinessHungary, VOSZ, Magyar Kereskedelmi Szövetségek in hospitality such as MVI, and the payment-adjacent Magyar Vendéglátók Ipartestülete) were not covered; they are cash-intensive-sector voices on cash-acceptance mandates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'MGYOSZ', 'VOSZ', 'Magyar Vendéglátók Ipartestülete készpénz' in Hungarian and add the acceptance-side positions.

coverage_gaps.description: Member directories for HFA and EFISZ, and the Bankszövetség working-group/committee structure (which would reveal the payments-specific subgroups), remain unenumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Browser-navigate hunfintech.com, efisz.hu and bankszovetseg.hu/szervezet to enumerate members and committees; snowball each member into the institutional actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy established for association content: association sites rewrite news indexes and PDFs disappear, and no Wayback/OSZK (EPA) mirroring was checked beyond noting REAL-J holds Gazdaság és Pénzügy issues.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check web.archive.org and epa.oszk.hu coverage for bankszovetseg.hu, oksz.hu and efisz.hu to establish back-series before starting live collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No English-language association output was located other than EFISZ's /en/ section; whether Bankszövetség, OKSZ or MKIK maintain English pages was not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Explicitly test /en and ?lang=eng variants on bankszovetseg.hu, oksz.hu, mkik.hu to see whether an English track exists for cross-country comparability.

brief: Hungary's association layer for banking and payments is concentrated in four bodies: Magyar Bankszövetség (the banking peak association, whose ~67-member 'Tagjaink' page is the master actor map including infrastructure members KELER and BISZ, and which publishes the quarterly journal Gazdaság és Pénzügy plus communiques rather than a statistics series), EFISZ (the Electronic Payment Service Providers Association, founded by GIRO, Magyar Posta, Magyar Telekom, OTP and others, and the only association running its own electronic-payment behaviour research), the Magyar Fintech Szövetség for the non-bank provider ecosystem, and OKSZ for the merchant/acceptance side, where roughly a third of Hungarian retail turnover sits and where the public fight over mandatory cash acceptance versus card acceptance is being argued. A second tier of associations does publish genuine member-aggregated numbers - the Leasing Association's quarterly placement volumes and the Factoring Association's turnover and GDP-penetration series are the cleanest quantitative assets in this cell - while MKIK and its research institute GVI supply long-running enterprise surveys with financial-sector breakouts. The important negative result is that no association publishes a recurring HU banking, card or ATM statistics series and no dedicated cards/ATM association exists, so A4's quantitative core must come from the central bank cell; associations here are best treated as pointer and positioning sources. Coverage is overwhelmingly Hungarian-language (only EFISZ was seen with an English track), so English-first collection would miss most of this landscape.
